common.evidence_contract: No independent multiplication of the five views; each is derived from exactly one qualified experiment

studies.target: local kinematical tensors and physically typed functionals
studies.x: joint signed carrier+physics pullback; normal/matter/observer frames separately
studies.Q: valid physical convex body else PRIOR_CONDITIONAL, statistical ellipsoid separately
studies.Pi: specified source posterior vs matched frequency null, never interchange
studies.F: occupancy only if finite reference body+measure; retain signed state
studies.GF: physical time/depth with full joint covariance, else NA
studies.key_gain: target-specific identification modulus, not new full-data Fisher information
studies.blocking: some physical x_C and calibration/MES anchors unqualified

studies.target: finite-band photon radiation stress and typed optical response
studies.x: signed alm and radiation STF5 plus PR3-PR4 paired processing
studies.Q: K_rad= {S: trace S=0, S+I/3 PSD}; exact gauge max(0,-3 lambda_min)
studies.Pi: simulation calibrated fixed-or-scanned axis null; no chi1 when optimize axis
studies.F: occupation in radiation stress body with source-qualified measure
studies.GF: NOT_APPLICABLE for one last scattering sky; release change is processing
studies.key_gain: invariant signed eigenvalue shape and physically positive body
studies.blocking: actual Commander matched temperature MC, beam/foreground/source transport

studies.target: source-count dipole per flux and selection
studies.x: signed dipole, flux bins, membership and selection response
studies.Q: survey selection/calibration-feasible body, not unit-norm physical speed
studies.Pi: conditional ring likelihood with clustering and source-component covariance
studies.F: only with a frozen catalog selection measure and bounded source body
studies.GF: flux-threshold path is NOT cosmological depth
studies.key_gain: separate shared-source contrast and directional response
studies.blocking: source association, LSS correlations and cross-survey overlap

studies.target: sigma/H, omega/H, A/(cH), beta of specified congruence
studies.x: physical STF5+axial3+polar3+relative velocities, tensor mixed products
studies.Q: causality and GR Einstein constraints only where physically derived
studies.Pi: source-matched radial and nonradial law with calibration
studies.F: partial set occupancy only if physical measure specified; support remains auxiliary
studies.GF: covariant Fermi/parallel transport and actual depth/time overlap
studies.key_gain: rank + stability of target, including omega null under radial-only data
studies.blocking: physical weak-lensing/astrometric response to the same matter congruence

studies.target: Bianchi structure constants, intrinsic curvature and tilted source history
studies.x: signed STF orbit plus a_i, n_ij, geometry and matter tilt
studies.Q: Jacobi, Hamiltonian, momentum and stress constraints
studies.Pi: family transfer likelihood and nonregular boundary/null law
studies.F: no canonical uniform over noncompact family parameter space
studies.GF: physical Bianchi history only with Einstein and optical transfer
studies.key_gain: stratified orbit invariants plus constraint-compatible candidate exclusion

studies.x: source log-distance, radial derivatives, signed mono/dipole/STF
studies.Q: D_L positivity and derivative H_D positive with physical optical conditions
studies.Pi: method/shared source covariance, PV and selection-calibrated null
studies.GF: redshift transport and actual cross-shell covariance
studies.blocking: heterogeneous distance-indicator shared calibration and source selection

studies.target: observer O relative to radiation R and matter M; normal N distinct
studies.x: beta_O|R, beta_M|R, beta_M|N, Gaia observer acceleration E1 and frame-spin B1 separate
studies.Q: causal speed ball with physical source-frame convention
studies.Pi: CMB aberration, radio count, Gaia/ICRF, kSZ remote dipole distinct null laws
studies.F: optional if an admitted physical reference measure exists
studies.GF: actual compensated velocity history with frame/matter transport
studies.key_gain: distinguish observer derivative/velocity/global tilt rather than relabeling a dipole
studies.blocking: source-qualified independent anchor, bias windows, full cross law

publication_claim: NOT_READY_TO_SUBMIT; methodological framework, no new cosmological discovery
